1.Nf3 c5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.g3 b6 5.Bg2.strategy: Brings the king to safety behind the fianchettoed bishop. Most of the pieces are out, so the next decision concerns the centre: strike with a pawn break or keep up the pressure on the long diagonal and wait.

Completes a compact set-up: the bishop prepares castling, and the pawns on b6, c5 and e6 leave White no clear target. Black deliberately cedes space and relies on a later central or queenside pawn break for counterplay, so the game is a long manoeuvring battle in which patience counts.
1.Nf3 c5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.g3 b6 5.Bg2.name: English Opening: Symmetrical Variation, Hedgehog Defence
1.Nf3 c5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.g3 b6 5.Bg2.background: The Hedgehog formation first became extensively analysed in the 1970s, and it has kept its popularity as a system of development.
